dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the lighter dorsal midline and the slightly darker lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast white linear mark is located on the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible white linear scar is present on the lower third of the dorsal axis.
